name: How long does it typically take to replace sliding door rollers?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to replace sliding door rollers?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to replace sliding door rollers can vary depending on the door's size, type, and the extent of the damage. For a single standard sliding door with readily available parts, the process typically takes a few hours, usually between 2 to 4 hours. If there are complications like rusted hardware, track damage, or custom-sized rollers needed, it might extend the repair time. Our technicians aim for efficient service to minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement usually takes 2 to 4 hours for a standard door, but can vary based on door type and damage extent.
